text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
"Looking around the world, there are 
countless Umamusume racing festivals."

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
"The traditional Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, where top Umamusume from across 
the globe gather to compete for the title 
of world's best."

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
In America, Dubai, and Hong Kong, various 
international GⅠ races are held across one 
to two days.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
In Japan—the Grand Prix. The day where her 
side as a fan and her side as a competitor 
intersect.

The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. I was 
heading to the track with Chrono Genesis 
to watch live.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I thought you said you would watch 
my voluntary training today...
choice_data_list: Watching races is part of training, too.

text_block_list.text:
We set up a mock race the other day, 
but... Chrono Genesis suffered a crushing 
defeat.

She let herself get thrown off by the 
Front Runner's pace and ran out of steam. 
It was a performance completely unlike 
her.

Afterward, she threw herself into her 
training with even greater fervor than 
before.

From her demeanor, an obvious impatience 
was evident. Finally, on Friday—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Over the weekend, I'll go through the 
independent training routine you gave 
me...
choice_data_list:
Huh? But the Takarazuka Kinen is this 
weekend...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"As I am right now, I don't have the 
leeway to prioritize my hobbies, so..."

When it gets to this point, I really can't 
just overlook it.

Her greatest strengths are her explosive 
acceleration and race reading. Having 
watched so many races, she can naturally 
foresee the best possible development.

If you don't take in your surroundings, 
you can't read the race. Her current state 
of panic and tunnel vision will only end 
up destroying her greatest strengths.

"By watching the Takarazuka Kinen, I hope 
she regains her passion for racing 
history— and finds her true self again."

—And besides, she'll be at the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it... Since we were meeting so 
early in the morning, I had a sneaking 
suspicion.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“...Though knowing that and still boarding 
the train makes me just as bad, I 
suppose.”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: By the way, what's in this bag...?
choice_data_list:
Here are snacks and drinks. Help yourself 
to whatever you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much. I will gladly 
accept...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, the newspaper too...?
choice_data_list:
What do you think of the lineup for the 
Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The lineup has changed completely. This 
time, it's focused on the generation two 
years above us.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, having half the field be GⅠ 
Umamusume is pretty exciting."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The center of attention is, of course... 
Lilie-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Among all the runners in this race, she is 
the only one who has come through the 
Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"As a fellow Tiara-route Umamusume, I hope 
she doesn't lose to the Classic Triple 
Crown contenders!"
choice_data_list:
You've been keeping an eye on Schöne Lilie 
this whole time, after all.

You've been keeping an eye on Schöne Lilie 
this whole time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if I were able to vote, I think I 
would have voted for Lilie-san too...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget the tears of pure joy 
after crossing the finish line in last 
year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup...
choice_data_list:
(Yeah, she said the exact same thing 
before the last Arima Kinen.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for rambling on and on...! 
W-What caught your eye, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
A showdown between contemporaries who 
split the Classic Triple Crown, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I get it...! You mean the three from 
Lilie-san's generation, right!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The drama of their Classic Triple Crown 
was truly magnificent, wasn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Derby, a veteran Trainer 
finally became a Derby-winning Trainer 
after several decades.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho, a heavy track under 
torrential rain, a 3,000-meter fierce, 
mud-soaked battle...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You have a really good eye for 
things.
choice_data_list:
It's all thanks to the school newspaper 
column

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... There's truly no greater honor 
for a writer...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ………… Looking at it again like this—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...The Umamusume chosen by the fan vote 
carry that much drama with them, don't 
they?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And yet, there I was... talking so lightly 
about leaving my hoofprints in history...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"How utterly conceited of me. It's 
embarrassing, really..."
choice_data_list: Could it be... about the fan vote results?

text_block_list.text:
In the Takarazuka Kinen fan voting, Chrono 
Genesis ranked far below Gran Alegria and 
Loves Only You.

"It's true that looking at the placement 
alone, the result might not have been 
ideal. However—"
choice_data_list: So many people voted for you, didn't they?
So many people voted for you, didn't they?

text_block_list.text:
The vote count was by no means small. 
That's how many people are placing their 
hopes on her.
choice_data_list:
Though it's true the rivals of that era 
had quite the strong personalities...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufu... calling it "rich," really now.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you have a point... Rankings are 
relative; we should look at the total vote 
count.”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There are so many people who want to see 
me run...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That really took a weight off my 
chest.

It looks like it could pour rain at any 
moment, but she refuses to back down on 
watching the Takarazuka Kinen from the 
stands.
choice_data_list:
But I didn't even bring my camera today, 
so why?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because there's a live fanfare 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Takarazuka Kinen has its own 
special fanfare, which you only get the 
chance to hear once a year.
choice_data_list:
Huh? I thought it was the Kansai GⅠ 
fanfare.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. Then please, listen closely and 
enjoy today."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's the track entrance parade! 
Photos, photos...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Schöne Lilie surges to the front 
early on! This is a completely unexpected 
turn of events!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: No way, Lilie-san is in second place!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even though almost all of her races up 
until now were from behind...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
They've just passed the 1000m mark! The 
time is exactly 1 minute flat!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"It's an average pace for the Takarazuka 
Kinen. This just might mean... there's a 
chance...!"

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
I can do this... I can do this! Today of 
all days, today is the day...!

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't let my guard down! The final 
stretch is still ahead. I'll conserve my 
strength and get ready...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The final stretch... Lilie's pace still 
isn't dropping!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now comes the hill! The Hanshin stage 
features a hill right here!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... It feels good! With this... I can 
win—!

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text: From here! Yaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
"Give it everything! All of it! Push 
forward until no one can even touch your 
shadow!!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Gah!! She accelerated!
choice_data_list: They've taken the lead!
She's taken the lead!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Amazing! She's pulling even 
further ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's SchÃ¶n Lilie! SchÃ¶n Lilie pulls 
further away!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, keep going... Just a little 
more...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gh... Ms. Lilieeeeeeeee! Go get 
'eeeeeeeeeemmm!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Schön Lilie crosses the finish line in 1st 
place!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah......... I-I won...
choice_data_list: 1st place! Schönlilie, you were strong!
1st place! Schönlilie, you were strong!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes! She was strong... Truly... so 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I left nail marks in my palm... 
Before I knew it, I was just so lost in 
the moment...

When SchÃ¶n Lilie stepped into the 
Winner's Circle, she was enveloped in a 
round of applause from the entire crowd.

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy... to be able to stand here 
again. Fufu, the view at a GⅠ is truly 
exceptional...!

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
"The GⅠ Winner's Circle had always felt 
like a distant, unreachable place to 
me..."

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin JF, the Triple Tiara. Watching 
my classmates be crowned, repeating 
reflections and regrets over and over.

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I didn't want to give up. I 
adopted foreign training methods, did 
everything I possibly could.

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
And the victory she finally seized was the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I didn't set limits on myself 
and kept pursuing the possibilities...!

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever my heart felt ready to break, 
the warm, encouraging cheers were what 
kept me going."

text_block_list.name: Schön Lilie
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's cheers gave me boundless power 
today as well! Thank you so much!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on your Grand Prix 
victory!" "It's a victory seized by your 
own hard work!" "Thank you for showing us 
such a commanding win!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: Chrono!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I am terribly sorry... So many memories 
came rushing back, I was overcome with 
emotion...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Truly... congratulations, Lilie-san...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad I came to watch today. I was 
able to witness Lilie-san's victory, after 
all—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I was able to return to my roots.
choice_data_list: Back to basics?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My dream is—to create historic drama 
and leave behind my hoofprints.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I felt that way because I was captivated 
by the countless historic dramas woven by 
horse girls."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
What moved me to tears was— the sight of 
an Umamusume striving wholeheartedly.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Nearly crushed by massive expectations, 
Mejiro Ryan kept challenging them without 
running away.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Before the Overlord who boasted absolute 
strength, there was Meisho Doto-san, who 
never gave up no matter how many times she 
was brought to her knees...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
All the anguish and joy they experience on 
the way to seizing their dreams is utterly 
precious.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to become an Umamusume that people 
feel that way about, too...
choice_data_list:
I see. Then... do you see what you need to 
do?

Right. Then... do you see what needs to be 
done?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...I'm sorry for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I didn't think I had any special 
talent fit for making a historical drama, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: You don't need anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The kind of earnest figure people can't 
help but root for... In order to become 
that kind of Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Without rushing... I'll move forward true 
to myself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Believing that someday... I'll become 
someone chosen by history...!"
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis breaks away! In 1st place, 
it's Chrono Genesis!

In the mock race, Chrono Genesis achieved 
victory with a textbook, flawless race 
performance.
choice_data_list: It was absolutely perfect!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I also felt a real sense of 
accomplishment from my run today...!
choice_data_list:
Let's keep charging ahead like this until 
fall!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll train both mind and body this 
summer—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to head into the Shuka Sho with a 
stronger, more dependable Chrono 
Genesis...!
